quote: In CUPID, the main bolometer crystals will be grown from Li 2100MoO4. The Mo component will be enriched to ≥ 95% in 100Mo.

Based on the experience gained in the framework of the CUPID R&D projects, we selected NTDs for the readout of both the heat and light channel. The LDs consist of a thin Ge wafer acting as an absorber, coupled to an NTD.
The base design includes three acoustic sensors in every mDOM of the IceCube upgrade. In addition, stand-alone pinger units are positioned close to the locations of the POCAM light sources.
